about.value: Helen Prater is a Nashville artist whose work is inspired by Music City, USA. Her husband Mark, is a singer-songwriter, which keeps her immersed in Nashville's energetic vibe. Helen's paints an inspiration on canvas, digitally scans it, then transfers onto merchandise.
